facts.text: §11.3: “full and sole discretion” to classify even unlisted prohibited conduct; §11.4 expressly permits “Remove profits” and “Deny payouts”. Conduct-linked discretion, not unconditional earned-reward forfeiture.

§12.1–12.4: significant or unjustified deviations in lot size, strategy, frequency or exposure may disqualify/terminate. §15.2: “Passing does not guarantee a funded account.” Related to B2; no separate penalty.

2-Step Professional: “5 profitable days” for first payout, three for second and none thereafter, minimum 14 calendar days each. Fixed 10% max drawdown in funded stage; up to 90% split. Not a numeric consistency threshold.
facts.locator: 2-Step Professional > Simulated funded stage / Payout eligibility

rejected.B1: §11.4 payout removal follows classification of conduct, not an unrestricted right to remove earned rewards; §16.2 revokes access but does not explicitly remove earned rewards.
rejected.B3: §6.4 permits modifying fees or program rules at any time and §22 continued-use acceptance; neither explicitly states application to existing purchased accounts.
rejected.B6: §19 prohibits excessive demands/repeated complaints after resolution with termination without refund; no express public criticism/reputational harm ground.
rejected.E_HARSH: §4.5 denial/cancellation concerns false/inconsistent information or failed identity verification; ordinary KYC controls not coded.

toVerify.B7: §16.1 says funded accounts subject to separate agreements; need actual agreement and evidence of when provided.
